property_summary: For every call to C.transfer with a non-empty _tos array, the reference implementation always returns true; the mutant inverts the loop and returns false for some inputs (non-empty _tos), breaking this rule.
change_summary: Invert the loop condition to skip iterations (making inner calls only for indices >= _tos.length, effectively calling none) and return false — changes behavior when _tos non-empty by avoiding calls and returning false.
